description: This file declares the namespace WPEFramework::Plugin with utility functions related to network device properties, interface status, and configuration management, specifically for Ethernet and WiFi interfaces in a network management context.

classes.name: nmUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for network device property retrieval, interface control, and configuration management.

methods.name: wlanIface
methods.description: Returns the name of the WLAN interface.

methods.name: ethIface
methods.description: Returns the name of the Ethernet interface.

methods.name: convertPercentageToSignalStrength
methods.description: Converts a percentage value to a WiFi signal strength metric.

methods.name: caseInsensitiveCompare
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: wifiSecurityModeFromAp
methods.description: Determines WiFi security mode from access point flags.

methods.name: wifiFrequencyFromAp
methods.description: Calculates WiFi frequency from access point frequency value.

methods.name: getSecurityModeString
methods.description: Returns a string description of security mode based on flags.

methods.name: setNetworkManagerlogLevelToTrace
methods.description: Sets NetworkManager logging level to trace.

methods.name: setMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates or removes marker files for interface disable/enable.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.

methods.name: writePersistentHostname
methods.description: Writes the hostname to persistent storage.

methods.name: readPersistentHostname
methods.description: Reads the hostname from persistent storage.
